8 اِخْتَلَعَتْ (S, Mgh, K) مِنْ زَوْجِهَا, (Mgh,) (tropical:) She became divorced from her husband (S, Mgh, K) for a gift, or a compensation, from her, (S, K, accord. to different copies; some having بِبَذْلٍ; and others, بِبَبَدٍ;) or from another, (K,) or for her property given by her as a ransom to release her from him. (Mgh.) ＝
-A2- اختلعهُ: see 1, first sentence. ―
-b2- اختلعوهُ (tropical:) They took his property: (K, TA:) from the "Nawá- dir el-Aaráb." (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
